Visual speech features

CMP-6026A/CMP-7016A Audiovisual Processing

Autumn 2026

Learning objectives

By the end of this lecture, you should be able to:

  • Explain speech recognition as classification (classical and Deep NN models), and where visual features fit in.
  • Segment lips by colour and extract articulatory features from the binary mask.
  • Build a point distribution model of lip shape: landmarks, Procrustes alignment and PCA.
  • Compute the 1D and 2D DCT, and extract DCT features from a mouth-RoI image by keeping the low-frequency coefficients.

Content

  • Speech recognition models
  • Visual Features
  • Image segmentation
  • Shape-based
    • Point distribution models
    • PCA
  • Appearance-based
    • DCT Features
  • Model fusion
